description: Pruna's talking head video generation model. Provide a portrait image and either a speech script or an audio file, and the model generates a realistic video of the person speaking. Supports multiple voices, languages, and output resolutions.
mf_description: Pruna's talking head video generation model. Provide a portrait image and either a speech script or an audio file, and the model generates a realistic video of the person speaking. Supports multiple voices, languages, and output resolutions.
txt_docs:
parameters:
  image     : string. URL of the input portrait image (first frame). Supports jpg, jpeg, png, webp.
  audio     : (Default: None) string. URL of an audio file to drive the talking head. Takes priority over voice_script when both are provided.
  voice_script: (Default: None) string. Script for the person to say when no audio is uploaded.
  voice     : (Default: None) string. Voice for generated speech. Defaults to 'Zephyr (Female)'.
  voice_language: (Default: None) string. Output language for generated speech. Defaults to 'English (US)'.
  voice_prompt: (Default: None) string. Speaking style, tone, pacing or emotion instructions for the generated speech.
  video_prompt: (Default: None) string. Optional prompt for the video.
  resolution: (Default: None) string. Resolution of the generated video. Defaults to 720p.
  seed      : (Default: 0) integer. Random seed for reproducible generation.
  disable_safety_filter: (Default: False) boolean. Disable safety filter for prompts and input image. Defaults to true.
  disable_prompt_upsampling: (Default: False) boolean. When true, skip the prompt upsampler and pass the raw user prompt to the video model.
  webhook   : (Default: None) string. The webhook to call when inference is done, by default you will get the output in the response of your inference request

send the parameters as EITHER:
- JSON object (one key: value per parameter, binary as base64 or Data URL)
- HTTP multipart (one part per parameter).
